remarks: Simply Spectacular! Tucked away in a hidden enclave of North Santa Ana, this exquisite Tuscan-style estate is the kind of place you'd never know existed, and once you find it, you won't want to leave. Set within an exclusive community, this one-of-a-kind  retreat offers over 4,500 square feet of living space and six bedrooms, with every inch thoughtfully touched and extensively upgraded. The outdoor spaces are every bit as special as the interiors, each designed to be lived in and enjoyed.
